scene.primarySubject: Radiance and fire above a fiery throne with burning wheels; the throne is set in a vast cloud-hall, no formed figure seated.
scene.action: Thrones are placed in the cloud-hall; the throne of fiery flames burns steadily with its wheels of fire, and light radiates outward from its center.
scene.setting: A vast night-dark vision-chamber open to the heavens, with a fiery river-like expanse and thrones set in a wide hall of cloud.
scene.secondaryElements: Unoccupied thrones arranged around the central fiery throne; flames and burning wheels at its base; cloud banks lit from within.
scene.mood: Awe, solemn stillness and sacred majesty, with quiet reverence rather than spectacle.
scene.composition: Wide view of the cloud-hall with the central fiery throne at the center; radiance rising above it and framing the scene.

conditions.place: A vast night-dark vision-chamber open to the heavens, with a fiery river-like expanse and thrones set in a wide hall of cloud.
conditions.timeOfDay: Night vision, unchanging across the section.
conditions.weather: Clouds gathered in great banks, lit from within, with no rain or wind visible.
conditions.light: Fire and radiance pour from the central throne-area in a sustained glow, with cloud lit from within.
conditions.clothing: No formed attendants are shown in this moment; the central presence is radiance and fire only.

availableCast.name: The Israelite people (the children of Israel)
God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: The Israelite people walking in a long line across the dry sea-floor, bundles on their backs, toward the far shore.
scene.action: Families step forward through the middle of the sea; a child is carried, an elder leans on a staff; the walls of water hold steady on either side.
scene.setting: Dry sea-floor of the Red Sea between two standing walls of water, under a wide desert sky with distant shorelines on each side.
scene.secondaryElements: Radiance veiled by a dense, slowly moving cloud above the crossing, its fire-like glow at its heart, with only a faint suggestion of its edges; water walls glistening beside the path.
scene.mood: Awed, hushed and hopeful, with grief and weariness carried in the bundles and the slow steps.
scene.timeOfDay: Night, shifting toward the first grey light of dawn.
scene.composition: Wide view from low on the sea-floor, the water walls rising on both sides and the people's line receding toward the horizon, with the veiled radiance high above.

conditions.place: Dry sea-floor between two standing walls of water, under a wide desert sky with the Red Sea's shoreline distant on each side
conditions.timeOfDay: Night, shifting toward the first grey light of dawn across the section
conditions.weather: Still air, dense slowly moving cloud, a fire-like glow veiled above the crossing
conditions.light: Brilliant white-gold radiance without visible source, veiled by cloud with a fire-like glow at its heart; moonlight and faint dawn light on the water walls
conditions.clothing: Israelites in woven tunics and cloaks carrying bundles; Egyptians in linen with chariot gear; Moses in plain cloak

scene.primarySubject: The Samaritan kneeling beside the wounded traveler
